Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap & asks so we have alignment for next steps:

- Goal: 3-month pilot (approx. 8–12k/mo consumption) to validate latency and multi-tenant cost savings for your catalog search reranking use case.
- Success criteria: sub-100ms 95th pct latency for API calls and <20% cost delta vs current infra for average load.
- Commercial path question: does Gamma Retail prefer a PO-based invoice flow, marketplace purchase (AWS/GCP marketplace), or corporate card / prepay for an initial pilot?
- Procurement nuance: you mentioned finance may require vendor onboarding and a purchase order for SaaS. Can you confirm whether a PO is mandatory for pilots under $50k, or whether an exception is possible? If PO is required, please share the procurement contact and any forms.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm procurement path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and send the procurement form if applicable.
2) We draft a short SOW and DocuSign link for the pilot if procurement requires signed paperwork.
3) Priyom will prepare a short permitting spec for telemetry and data isolation for the pilot.

I can loop in Sales Ops / Finance to speed approvals if Gamma needs an exception (no-PO) or prepayment structure.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,

Hey Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement side:

- Gamma's standard policy is that all third-party SaaS engagements must go through our vendor onboarding and P2P system. Typically procurement issues a PO for any recurring service.
- Exception: for one-off purchases or very small pilots (<$5k) we sometimes allow a corporate card payment. For pilots expecting ongoing consumption or >$10k, procurement prefers a PO after vendor onboarding.
- Complication: our vendor master and AP system requires a completed procurement questionnaire and an approved supplier record before we can generate PO/invoice terms. I've attached the procurement questionnaire to this message.

Two ask items from our side:
1) Can Redwood accept corporate card payment for the initial pilot if we keep spend under $10k?
2) If not, can Redwood provide an invoice and net terms while we complete vendor onboarding (we generally only approve this for strategic vendors after legal signs an MSA)?

I'll loop Tom (IT procurement) for technical/vendor onboarding details.

Attaching: Gamma_Procurement_Form.pdf (filled template attached)

—Sara

On 2026-03-07 11:05, Sara Jenkins wrote:
> Hey Marissa —
> 
> Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from procurement side: ...

Hi Sara — thanks for the transparency. A few practical options from the Redwood side for pilots like this:

1) Card / Prepay: We can accept a corporate card for a 3-month pilot and issue monthly invoices reflecting consumption; this is the fastest way to start. For pilots under $10k total spend, we typically recommend card payment.

2) Marketplace: If Gamma purchases via the AWS/GCP marketplace, billing is consolidated through the marketplace and often sidesteps vendor onboarding for small pilots. We are listed on AWS Marketplace (let me know if you'd like the link) and can provide a marketplace quote.

3) Invoice / Net Terms (PO): For net-30 invoicing against a PO we require vendor onboarding to be completed; larger pilots (> $25k) often use this flow. For customers who need invoicing before onboarding, we can do a short credit review and require card-on-file or a prepayment.

Operational notes: We can draft a short SOW (1–2 pages) that captures scope, duration, and success criteria so procurement can review. If procurement requires an MSA prior to PO issuance, we can surface a standard Redwood MSA + any redlines.

If it helps I can join a quick call with Tom and your procurement lead to walk through the vendor-onboarding checklist and our marketplace options.

Best,
Priyom Das

Hi Sara — looping in Sales Ops to clarify our internal thresholds so procurement has a clear expectation.

- Short answer: for pilots <= $10k total we can usually accept card/prepay and start immediately.
- For pilot spend between $10k–25k we require either an upfront partial prepayment or a P-card with PO submitted; exceptions are case-by-case.
- For pilots > $25k we typically require vendor onboarding + PO and an executed SOW/MSA.

If Gamma needs to avoid a PO entirely, we can request an exception but those require approval from Sales leadership. Could you confirm expected monthly spend for the pilot (ballpark)? Also, please confirm whether you prefer marketplace billing — that often accelerates procurement.

Neha Kapoor

Hi Sara — thanks for sending the procurement form. I reviewed the ask and want to propose a pragmatic commercial path to remove friction:

1) For the initial 3-month pilot (up to $15k total): Redwood will accept corporate card payment or a single upfront prepayment. No PO required for this pilot if Gamma signs the short SOW and a minimal vendor questionnaire is completed.

2) If Gamma prefers invoicing, we can provide a net-30 invoice once vendor onboarding is complete; for invoicing without completed vendor setup we would require card-on-file or prepayment as credit protection.

3) If procurement absolutely cannot accept card/prepay, we will escalate a no-PO exception to Legal & Finance for approval; please note that approval may add 5–7 business days.

I'll approve the exception for this pilot up to $15k contingent on: a signed 1-page SOW (scope/dates) and completed procurement questionnaire. Marissa — can you push the SOW + DocuSign link? Priyom — happy to join a call with Tom if needed.

Regards,
